note: Chunk map for scripts/assemble-voice.js: Fish Audio task URLs, per section of voice-scripts.js, rendered in sentence-boundary chunks over the Fish Audio MCP connection (the free API caps one call at 500 bytes of text). Empty on purpose. The ten stock-voice section tracks it used to describe were retired in September 2026 (scripts/generate-voice.js says why); the site reads its sections with the visitor's browser voice and plays one recording, Moses's own introduction. With no sections listed, the assembler changes nothing. To use it again, add {"id": "<section>", "urls": [...]} entries and fill in voiceId, voiceTitle, voiceKind and model, then run the 'Assemble voice narration' workflow by hand.
